claims.assertion: Mari reports a Centauri Black Knight fighter crashed in northern Mexico after disappearing; a cloaking or frequency-blocking device is her speculation, based on Centauri forces rather than Viera traffic control.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She says the report could mask a more complex situation.

claims.assertion: Mari says the fighter’s ejection pod was found empty about a mile away, leaving two pilots missing; Centauri requested help, and Queen Alenym sent Hashmallim special forces to search.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She marks the suggestion that the pilots entered the desert as speculation.

coverage_gaps: Black Knight incidents and blockade claims
